WFCAT-001.note: Reuses only approved PCA action IDs for seven existing native actions; all 436 ledger mappings/action authorities and approval remain Required.

WFCAT-002.note: Configured captures freeze workflow ID/name/type/actions/chooser intent, use existing pipeline task IDs/timings/results, and retain safe snapshot metadata in private journals. Full invocation origin/settings/acquisition-failure coverage remains Required. Effective output folder/pattern now freeze before acquisition and remain in known-field result/journal/retry snapshots. Explicit-ID invocation freezes the saved profile/output at primary admission before acknowledgement. Private portal/controller evidence proves original output after a profile edit, then changed output on the next invocation. Activation request ID is not the pipeline task ID; origin/result linkage remains Required.

WFCAT-003.note: Explicit full-UUID CLI activation now shares the authenticated dispatcher and actual controller with Run selected. Read-only workflow IDs are available in the manager. Global hotkeys, discovery, MCP/watch-folder/automation entry points remain Required.

WFCAT-004.note: Configured supported actions retain existing PCA succeeded/failed/skipped/cancelled and interruption facts; unavailable definitions fail before acquisition. Complete workflow status taxonomy/families remain Required.

WFCAT-005.note: Saved selections use the existing normative PCA engine order and independent/dependent failure policy. Remaining post-upload/action families remain Required.

WFCAT-006.note: Configured runs use existing observable controller/pipeline cancellation and retain their frozen profile in results/retry. Full family cancellation/cleanup matrices remain Required.

WFCAT-007.note: Named region profiles use the existing portal/overlay permission and capture path, with pre-acquisition validation. Mixed-display/DPI/cursor/HDR/recording scope and human permission review remain Required.

WFCAT-008.note: Profiles select existing image/file/path clipboard outputs; actual native GUI dispatch and saved-file prerequisites remain shared. Other clipboard input/format workflows and full privacy/target qualification remain Required.

WFCAT-009.note: Existing save/new-PNG/file-reveal validation and authority are reused. Workflow configuration is private/atomic, detects external changes and confirms profile deletion. Other file/folder/index/external/destructive families remain Required. Profiles now save absolute folders and portable filename patterns. Folder validation rejects relative/traversal/control input; production Save validates before I/O and retains no-replacement collisions. Native picker and independent failure behavior are verified; complete filesystem/authority review remains Required.

WFCAT-010.note: Uploads/destinations/credential and URL authority remain Required. Unavailable actions are preserved visibly and cannot execute.

WFCAT-011.note: Profiles can invoke the existing region-image annotation/output path. OCR/QR/hash/combine/split/effects/tools and complete family input/metadata schemas remain Required.

WFCAT-012.note: Recording control/session state machines remain Required; recording definitions are retained but unavailable.

WFCAT-013.note: Run Selected checks capture availability and current modal work, and uses an immutable saved definition. Full application-control/headless-authority behaviors remain Required. --non-interactive refuses graphical operations before QApplication/display, election, preference initialization or portal consent. No headless execution authority is added. Full application-control/headless operation coverage remains Required.

WFCAT-014.note: Configured captures preserve existing single-controller busy arbitration and worker snapshots; changes affect future runs. Full concurrency policies across all resources and entry points remain Required. Workflow admission reserves a single pending operation and snapshots saved settings; busy/modal conflicts and preparation reentry fail without acquisition. Late conflicts release the reservation. Choose-actions now uses ordinary dispatch so subsequent workflows can run. Full resource/concurrency policy remains Required.

WFCAT-015.note: Explicit retained retry keeps the original workflow snapshot and successful outputs after profile edits; no configuration reread/repeat is introduced. Other idempotency/remote families remain Required. Retained save retry now proves original folder/pattern use after the profile destination/name changes. Private activation UUID/payload receipts prevent duplicate dispatch within the bounded primary lifetime; changed workflow payload with the same request ID is rejected and missing acknowledgement never auto-resends. This does not establish durable exactly-once or remote idempotency.

WFCAT-016.note: Native-only v1 profiles use UUIDs and existing PCA IDs; validate bounded definitions/default membership before execution; preserve unknown compatible fields/actions; reject corrupt/newer/unsupported execution and detect stale writes. Shared interchange/migration/import/presets and compatibility/human review remain Required. Private v2 output definitions read v1 default semantics and upgrade only on explicit Save. Unknown v1 output authority is refused/preserved; nested compatible v2 output fields round-trip. Native unsupported counters/file reads are explicit. The private v1 activation protocol adds strict workflow_id-only run-workflow and payload-free capture-region-choose-actions names; older instances reject unknown actions. Saved-definition resolution now lives in the QtCore domain store. No shared interchange/schema acceptance is claimed.

WFCAT-017.note: Results and private restart journals retain a known-field-only workflow snapshot and existing truthful outcomes. Unknown extensions are excluded from reports. Full notifications/log/privacy/terminal-state convergence remains Required. Nested output extensions are excluded from reports while known private folder/pattern fields stay available to explicit review. Versioned CLI JSON contains admission/delivery, stable errors and valid opaque IDs only; it does not publish private names/actions/folders/patterns or claim terminal output success. Complete result convergence and execution/result lookup remain Required.

WFCAT-018.note: Core/native UI/restart/real-output/private-portal cases cover the supported profile slice. No published WORKFLOW vectors exist; CMake reports that absence explicitly, following CORE precedent. All approved action-family vectors, platform adapters and human activation gates remain Required. Core protocol/dispatcher, actual child application and private-portal real-controller tests now cover workflow-ID admission, safe JSON, headless refusal, profile snapshots, failure/busy/unknown delivery and reservation release. Published WFCAT vectors, full target matrix and human gates remain Required.
